main_text.p: locorum intercapedine disjunctus. Scri-psisse ergò dicamus, sive in conversorum jam gratiam, illis de Evangelij naturâ & Legis usu planius erudiendis, sive nō conversorum, arguendis iis, si quando in illo-rum manus scriptum incideret, ac con-vincendis.
VII. Atque hoc argumentum, plerique ex vetustissimis[?] Patribus urgentius visum fuit. Athanasius, Synopsi S. Script. Lib. VII. [illegible, ~40 letters]

Postquam scripserat omnibus Gentibus, scribit de cetero etiam omnibus ex circumcisione credentibus &c. Chrysostomus, Præfat. in Ep. [illegible, ~30 letters], quomodo non ad illos scripsisset pro quibus & anathema fieri voluit. Isidorus Pelusiota, Epistolarum Lib. 1. Epist. ccccvii. [illegible, ~45 letters] Qui pro Israelitis anathema fieri voluit, quid ille non sustinuit, vel fecit, ut salutis fierent com-munes? Consenserunt Theodoretus, Oecu-menius,

page.notes: The Greek lines are heavily blurred at this scan resolution. Only fragments are legible, so the Greek passages are marked as illegible rather than guessed. The running head's final letter and the word "vetustissimis" are doubtful. The line "ut salutis fierent communes?" is partly obscured at the line end.
